translations.en: so please do your best!
You are to find some old coins at @7rTanya's@0r request.
If you explore the ruined city,
you should find old coins soon enough.
It should not be a difficult job.
You only need to find what @7rTanya@0r wants: the @3rAncient Coin@0r.
Without giving it much thought,
you decide to accept @7rTanya's@0r request.
I don't know if this will help,
but old money often turns up
in places marked Skua.
translations.note: Skua is provisional place-name orthography. Requires agreement with sign text.

translations.en: And... in a place called Kayuken, too.
translations.note: Kayuken is provisional place-name orthography. Requires agreement with sign text.

translations.en: If you find any signs, please have a good look around!
I'm counting on you!
You can't?
That's a real shame...
But I guess it can't be helped.
If you change your mind, come and talk to me anytime!
Hello.

translations.en: Have you all been doing well?
@7rTanya's@0r doing great, as always!
@7rTanya@0r is smiling as cheerfully as ever.
You ask whether anything has changed
since the incident.
Ever since that big light and the earthquake,
people in town seem really frightened.
That legendary wizard, Chu, Chu... what was his name?
Well, anyway. People say that legendary wizard's curse
has grown even stronger.
And ever since the earthquake, the ruins around town
have been full of monsters, so it's dangerous now.
@7rBeatrix@0r says the seal has weakened,
and monsters are coming through the gaps.
But the earthquake knocked down walls and things,
and people found new ruins. I think that's where
the monsters are coming from. That's what @7rTanya@0r thinks!
Oh, speaking of the new ruins!
I've got a favor to ask. Will you help me?
My grandma likes collecting old money.
@7rBeatrix@0r says
the ruins they found used to be a city,
so I bet there's old money there.
If you find any, could you bring it to me?
Please?
You received a @3rKramer Hat@0r.
Thank goodness. We made it back to civilization safely.
I'll devote myself to deciphering this memorandum.
That should tell us what those attackers were after,
and perhaps who this sealed demon god is.
Thank you for today, at any rate.
Here's the reward I promised.
From @7rBeatrix@0r, you received @3r25,000 G@0r and
Once I've deciphered it, I may have another request.
I'll be counting on you then.
From @7rBeatrix@0r, you received @3r25,000 G@0r.
If you're ready, let's be on our way.
We're going to @6rBahelmeja@0r, to the site of @7rChu Lu Gah's@0r house.
Have you decided to check whether it's the key to the library?
I'd be delighted if you have.
Thank you. I don't want to make two trips,
so I'll accompany you. Please keep me safe.
I'll pay you extra in return.
Is that all right?
Whether it is or not, having already agreed,
you cannot very well refuse just because @7rBeatrix@0r
is coming along.
You nod reluctantly,
while @7rBeatrix@0r beams back at you.
It's easier than checking the library key and then
having to escort me all the way back there afterward, isn't it?
No, then?
Well, we don't know for certain that the coin is the key,
and it's yours, after all. I can't make you.
But if you change your mind, come and see me anytime.
Even a one percent chance is worth trying, I think.
Did you have it appraised? What did you find out?
When you explain the details to @7rBeatrix@0r,
she frowns slightly and hides her mouth behind her iron fan.
So we still don't know whether it's the library key.
But it is the right size...

context: Tanya asks for old coins for her grandmother; Beatrix later offers an escort job to investigate the locked library.
